fields.summary_ko.0: J.P. Morgan Asset Management listed the JPMorgan All Country Research Enhanced Equity ETF (JALL) with $250 million in scale on NYSE Arca, with leading commercial insurer FM investing in the initial fund.
fields.summary_ko.1: J.P. Morgan, the global leading active ETF issuer, saw active ETF inflows increase more than 18 times in 2025 compared to 2019, with 2026 year-to-date inflows already reaching $590 billion, with international equities and bonds accounting for over 30% of the mix.
